codeLivewirePhp:
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class StatusVocabularyPrimitives extends Component
{
    private const AMOUNTS = ['USD' => [420000, 670000], 'EUR' => [180000, 300000]];
    public bool $pending = true;
    #[Locked] public string $currency = 'USD';

    public function selectCurrency(string $code): void
    {
        abort_unless(isset(self::AMOUNTS[$code]), 422);
        $this->currency = $code;
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        return view('livewire.status-vocabulary-primitives', [
            'amounts' => self::AMOUNTS[$this->currency],
            'approved' => 99, 'awaiting' => 6, 'target' => 120,
        ]);
    }
}
